Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About The Team

Join our Issuance Product team to shape the future of financial access and infrastructure. We're not just improving global payments, we're reinventing them with modern rails that allow for fast, cheap transactions at any size. You will build a platform that powers issuing compliant stablecoins in US/EU and beyond. We work with some of the largest fintechs, crypto companies, blockchains and more. This is your chance to lead meaningful innovation from day one, redefining the way businesses and people exchange value globally.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Build a world class issuance platform that has the scale to power billions of dollars of transactions and issued stablecoins. Product areas include liquidity delivery, reserves management, mint/burn infrastructure, rewards, on-chain/crypto smart contracts, and launching custom stablecoins.
  • Drive product features from ideation to launch, collaborating with designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners such as legal and compliance.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our users’ needs, operational landscape, and competitive environment across international markets.
  • Own outcomes end-to-end, using data, feedback, and rapid iteration to refine your approach.
  • Make tough prioritization calls, balancing user needs, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Drive high-traffic features at scale, ensuring security, speed, and reliability for millions of users.


Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • Empathy for users: You’re passionate about uncovering and solving pain points.
  • Deep curiosity: You never stop asking “why” and dig into both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Owner’s mentality: You tackle challenges head-on and drive solutions with conviction.
  • Collaborative spirit: You work seamlessly with team members but aren’t afraid to make the call when needed.
  • Clarity and simplicity: You translate complex systems into intuitive, straightforward user experiences.
  • Bias for learning: You embrace mistakes as opportunities to grow and improve quickly.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years in product management or a related role, with a proven record of delivering impactful products.
  • Demonstrated success working with engineers, designers, and external partners to build complex systems.
  • Strong business acumen and comfort navigating ecosystem and platform-level challenges.
  • Experience integrating APIs, managing developer platforms, or building ecosystem-driven products.
  • Experience building regulated infrastructure in fintech, payments, or crypto.


If you’re ready to shape the future of how money moves, we want to hear from you!

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $178,600 - $268,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

About Roofstock

What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

The Senior Product Manager, Leasing is the dedicated product leader for Leasing on the Leasing & Resident Experience team. This is a hands-on, high-ownership position over a revenue-carrying surface for someone who thrives at the intersection of Product, Operations, and Growth. You will own the leasing roadmap end to end, deliver the products that help our teams lease more homes faster, and shape new leasing offerings for the landlords who manage on their own.

This role is built for an operator-minded product manager with a bias toward action, a focus on driving outcomes, strong written communication, and a genuine curiosity about how homes actually get leased. If you look at a leasing pipeline and your first instinct is to find the stage where prospects quietly stall, then fix the system so it stops happening, this is your job.

What You'll Own

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the leasing product roadmap across our retail, institutional, and build-to-rent portfolios, balancing platform commitments against growth opportunities
  • Lead initiatives from discovery through execution, partnering with Engineering and Design on scoping, rollout planning, and post-launch impact analysis
  • Keep priorities, sizing, and sequencing legible so leadership, engineering, and operations are all reading from the same plan

Leasing Funnel Performance

  • Build the visibility and workflow layer for the leasing funnel so handoffs, service levels, and automation status are clear and the team sees what needs attention without digging
  • Partner with leasing operations to remove bottlenecks and help the team absorb more volume without proportionally adding headcount
  • Understand how AI is working within the leasing funnel, from screening to scheduling to prospect communication, well enough to push automation where it helps and catch quality issues before customers do

New Leasing Offerings

  • Shape and validate new leasing products and services for self-managing landlords, from customer discovery through pricing and business modeling
  • Partner with Growth and go-to-market teams to take new offerings from thesis to launch

Customer Research and Insight

  • Talk directly to the people who live in the funnel, including owners, prospects, leasing agents, and screeners, and synthesize what you hear into decisions the team can act on
  • Build and maintain the feedback loops that keep operational signals flowing into product decisions in real time, not after the damage is done

Cross-functional Operations

  • Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering and Design and the point of contact for cross-team dependencies across sales, operations, and account management
  • Support prioritization decisions by balancing strategic goals and operational capacity

Data and Metrics

  • Own leasing funnel metrics end to end, including conversion, speed to lease, service-level adherence, and vacancy
  • Develop and track KPIs that surface risks and opportunities early, and identify root causes when results deviate from expectations

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years of product management experience, including ownership of a revenue-carrying product surface at a software company
  • Proptech, real estate, or marketplace background strongly preferred; leasing or property management context is a strong plus. You should know, or be hungry to learn, how a home actually gets leased
  • Grit. You've shipped through ambiguity and constraint, and you can tell us how
  • Strong roadmap and stakeholder management. You can hold deadline-bound platform work and growth bets in the same quarter and keep both moving
  • Comfort in an operator-heavy business; your best discovery starts by shadowing the people doing the work today
  • AI fluency. You use AI tools every day and have opinions about where agents belong in a workflow. You don't need to write code, but you should have put AI into a product, not just into your own productivity
  • Comfort working with data; you can define funnel metrics, read a dashboard, and root-cause a number that moved the wrong way
  • Strong written communication. You can take a messy situation and write a clear one-pager about it
  • Genuine curiosity about customers and comfort talking to them directly, whether that is an institutional owner, a self-managing landlord, or a prospect stuck in screening
  • Bias toward action over perfect planning

Location

This position is classified as a HYBRID work environment in Oakland, CA or NYC, New York. 

This is a 2 day hybrid role in the Bay Area office, effective October 2026. 

Compensation

$214,000 - $225,000 annual base salary. The compensation range may be adjusted based on experience and location.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position.  Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors.  Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only part of our total compensation package.

General Motors pioneers the innovations that move and connect people to what matters. We see a world with zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion.   • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive projects forward, even without a clear path.

  • Demonstrated expertise in writing, with the ability to effectively balance and integrate vision, strategy, and technical details in a cohesive narrative.

Who We Are

Our Financing & Loyalty Technology team builds the products that shape how customers pay for their homes and what they get back for choosing us — consumer financing across multiple providers, the Wayfair Credit Card, and Wayfair Rewards, our membership program. Together these are among the most direct levers Wayfair has on customer lifetime value, and they touch millions of customers every week.

Furnishing a home is expensive. A sofa, a mattress, a full room — these are purchases customers plan around, and for many of them the ability to pay over time is what turns a browse into an order. Financing is one of the most direct levers we have on whether a customer can say yes.

Wayfair offers financing through a portfolio of third-party partners. Each brings different economics, approval characteristics, promotional mechanics, and product features which creates experience tension and opportunity. We strive to create capabilities that work across every partner, so that adding the next one is a configuration rather than a rebuild. We also want to take genuine advantage of what makes each partner distinctive, where the payoff justifies the specificity.

You will own the financing experience across the full funnel. That starts well before checkout — helping customers understand affordability while they are still browsing, and surfacing targeted prequalification at the moments where it helps rather than intrudes — and runs all the way through cart and checkout, where the customer chooses how to pay. It also includes our financing messaging: both the everyday presentation of monthly pricing and terms, and the special promotional campaigns we run through the year, along with the toolkit that makes those campaigns repeatable instead of bespoke every time.

This is a highly collaborative role. Financing sits next to the Wayfair Credit Card, Rewards, and Payments, and the customer does not experience these as separate products — so you will work closely with those teams, alongside Engineering, Design, Data Science, Analytics, Commercial, and Legal. Externally, you will be the day-to-day product counterpart to our financing partners.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product plan for financing: Turn business goals into a clear roadmap, well-defined requirements, and epics your team can build against. Sequence the work and keep it moving.
  • Build across the portfolio, not partner by partner: Develop shared capabilities — eligibility, offer presentation, routing, messaging — so that supporting an additional financing partner does not mean starting over.
  • Make the most of each partner: Identify where a specific partner offers something genuinely differentiated, and make the call on when that is worth building for directly
  • Target the right provider and offer to the right customer: Decide who sees which financing option and which offer, rather than showing everyone the same thing. Work with Data Science on eligibility signals, prequalification targeting, and personalized purchase power
  • Own the full-funnel experience: Build affordability awareness in the upper funnel, targeted prequalification through the middle, and a clear, trustworthy tender experience in cart and checkout.
  • Run financing messaging and promotions: Own everyday monthly-pricing and terms messaging across surfaces, deliver the special promotional financing campaigns, and build the toolkit that makes each campaign faster than the last.
  • Partner across the portfolio: Work closely with the Credit Card, Rewards, and Payments teams so that what a customer sees across these products is coherent rather than competing.
  • Manage the partner relationship day to day: Be the product counterpart to our third-party financing providers — translate program mechanics and contractual commitments into requirements, and keep integrations healthy.
  • Get the details right: Financing is full of edge cases and real constraints. Work with Legal and Compliance so that disclosures, terms, and promotional claims are accurate everywhere they appear.
  • Measure and iterate: Define success metrics, track financing attach and approval rates and their effect on conversion and order value, and run structured experiments with Data Science to validate what works.
  • Keep everyone current: Run product forums with your key partners, integrate their feedback, and update stakeholders in the way that suits each audience.

We Are a Match Because

  • You have 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in consumer fintech, payments, lending, or e-commerce checkout.
  • You are comfortable owning a product plan and a set of requirements against defined outcomes, and you execute autonomously once you know what the goal is.
  • You have worked with third-party integrations or vendors, and you understand that the partner relationship is part of the product rather than a procurement detail.
  • You are detail-oriented. You notice the edge case, the missing disclosure, and the state nobody designed for — and you care enough to chase it down.
  • You are analytical and comfortable working directly with data to size an opportunity, diagnose a problem, and read a test result honestly.
  • You have enough technical fluency to work well with engineers on how a system should behave. You do not need to write code, but you should be able to follow and contribute to the conversation.
  • You communicate clearly and build credibility quickly with engineering, design, and business partners.
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
